crew.overview: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.
crew.title: Killers of the Flower Moon

crew.original_title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada
crew.overview: When brash Texas border officer Mike Norton wrongfully kills and buries the friend and ranch hand of Pete Perkins, the latter is reminded of a promise he made to bury his friend, Melquiades Estrada, in his Mexican home town. He kidnaps Norton and exhumes Estrada's corpse, and the odd caravan sets out on horseback for Mexico.
crew.title: The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada

details.biography: Sean Happy is a Stunt Performer known for The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift (2006), The Three Burials of Melquiades Estrada (2005) and Killers of the Flower Moon (2023). Sean comes from a family of stunt performers, including his father Clifford his mother Marguerite and brother Ryan.
details.name: Sean Happy
